name: Technisches Museum Wien
notes: Listing page has no dates, only links to /ausstellung/<slug> detail pages (9 of them). Each detail page has an ExhibitionEvent JSON-LD block with start/end; some blocks contain unescaped control chars so json.loads needs strict=False. Descriptions are double HTML-escaped (e.g. &lt;sup&gt;), so ea.text() is applied twice. The site's own JSON-LD endDate for permanent (Dauerausstellung) exhibits is a fabricated far-future sentinel (e.g. 3000-03-12, 2040-09-01) — detected via the listing page's kategorie badge ('dauerhaft') or 'Dauerausstellung' in the description, and for those end is forced to null with extra.permanent=true instead of passing the sentinel through. No admission price found on detail pages, so price_min/price_text left null (general museum ticket applies, amount not stated here).
